description: The shared throwaway test-database helper (TI1, D-064 (b), D-069 items 3 and 5): naming, maintenance database and psql limit of every database a test creates and destroys.

test-db.ddl_lock_path.description: Machine-wide lock file taken by the helper around CREATE DATABASE and DROP DATABASE. Both force a checkpoint on the shared test cluster; taking turns keeps parallel script tests from stacking checkpoints on one cluster, so a single drop does not wait on the others (KF3).

test-db.ddl_lock_poll_s.description: Pause between two tries for test-db.ddl_lock_path while another caller holds it.

test-db.ddl_lock_wait_s.description: Longest the helper waits for test-db.ddl_lock_path before it raises. It covers queueing behind other callers only; the psql limit (test-db.psql_timeout_s) starts after the lock is held, so waiting in line never counts against it and the 30 s limit is unchanged.

test-db.maintenance_database.description: Database the helper connects to when it creates, terminates backends of and drops a throwaway database (the same maintenance database gate-isolation.sh uses).

test-db.name_prefix.description: Prefix of every throwaway test database. The character after tower_test_ is never hex and never g, so a helper name never matches the per-checkout database tower_test_<10 hex> (scripts/lib/gate-isolation.sh) or an integration database tower_test_g<hex>; the helper drops only names with this prefix.

test-db.name_token_bytes.description: Random bytes, written as hex after the prefix, that make one throwaway database name unique.

test-db.psql_timeout_s.description: Limit of one psql call of the helper (create, terminate, drop, existence check); the same 30 s limit the claude-session cleanup had. A call over it raises, never passes silently.
